generic_sampling_rules.text_short_enum: Sample from the explicit enum pool for the column; include near-variants (case changes, trailing space) only for columns listed in per_column_exceptions; otherwise exact enum values only.
generic_sampling_rules.text_identifier: Generate fresh unique identifiers matching the column's observed format (prefix pattern + zero-padded number); never reuse a value across rows of the same table.
generic_sampling_rules.text_free: Sample from a small pool of plausible strings; allow near-duplicates (case/whitespace variants) at ~5% share when the column is not a key.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_key: Sequential or random unique integers within [1, 100000]; never NULL for primary keys; when appending to a copied compact database, exclude integers already present in the compact table.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_quantity: Uniform integer in [1, 14]; never 0 or negative.
generic_sampling_rules.real_amount: Uniform real in [0, 10000], rounded to 3 decimals; allow negative only where a profit column permits it.
generic_sampling_rules.real_profit: Uniform real in [-5000, 5000], rounded to 4 decimals; sign free.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For each nullable column, ~2% of generated rows get NULL (at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance); NOT NULL and PK columns never NULL; planted boundary/tie/duplicate rows are excluded from NULL sampling; a NULL in any column of a composite FK makes the constraint satisfied (SQLite semantics) and is permitted.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_and_tie: Planting is deterministic and last: sample all columns first, then plant boundary/tie/duplicate values on dedicated protected rows, then enforce semantics without touching protected rows, then apply NULL excluding protected rows, then deduplicate. For comparison_boundary, plant values at each listed literal and one step on each side; for ties_for_order_limit, plant at least two rows sharing the listed rank value, where the shared value is the actual rank-k value under the stated direction (for rank 1 DESC, the maximum; no other row exceeds it); for duplicates_for_distinct, plant duplicate values at the listed share. Assert planted values survive.

supporting_evidence.region_enums: people.Region distinct=4; product.Region distinct=4; each superstore table Region distinct=1 matching its name (central rows 1-8 all 'Central', east rows 4647-4654 all 'East', south rows 10343-10350 all 'South', west rows 13583-13590 all 'West').
supporting_evidence.ship_mode_enum: All four superstore tables show Ship Mode values in {Standard Class, First Class, Second Class, Same Day} (central rows 1-8, east 4647-4654, south 10343-10350, west 13583-13590).
supporting_evidence.quantity_range: Quantity distinct=14 in all superstore tables; shown values 1-14.
supporting_evidence.discount_range: Discount distinct 5-9, shown values 0.0-0.8, all within [0,1].
supporting_evidence.discount_boundary_reconciled: central_superstore.Discount boundary target -0.01 removed because it contradicts Discount BETWEEN 0 AND 1; boundary planted at 0 and 0.01 only.
supporting_evidence.tie_rank_definition: Tie values are the actual rank-k values under the stated direction (max for rank 1 DESC); no other row exceeds the rank-1 tie value.
supporting_evidence.region_fk_reconciliation: Per-table Region rule is reconciled with the copied-Region dependency by restricting the parent draw pool per superstore table to parent rows of the matching region and copying Region from the parent (option a). The copied value therefore equals the fixed region, and non-NULL composite FK tuples always exist in the parent.
supporting_evidence.fk_integrity: FK columns are generated as whole composite tuples drawn from the in-memory parent; non-NULL composite FK tuples always reference an existing parent tuple; NULL in any FK column satisfies the composite constraint (SQLite semantics).
supporting_evidence.planting_order: Planting is deterministic and last: sample all columns, plant boundary/tie/duplicate values on protected rows, enforce semantics without touching protected rows, apply NULL excluding protected rows, deduplicate; assertions confirm planted values survive.

uncertainty: Profit has no verified closed-form formula on the shown rows; it is sampled freely within [-5000,5000]. The expression sales/(1-discount)*quantity boundary at 80000 is a construction target only, not a semantic rule. NULL shares are set to ~2% since observed null_rate is 0 but nullable columns must exercise NULL. Exact identifier formats inferred from samples (XX-NNNNN for Customer ID, XXX-XX-NNNNNNNN for Product ID). Lowercase Region boundary variants for superstore tables are listed as targets but the per-table Region semantic rule forces exact 'Central'/'East'/'South'/'West'; the program plants lowercase variants only where the rule permits (i.e., not in superstore Region columns) or relaxes the rule for those planted rows.
